rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.quote: The Office of Landlord Tenant Relations administers and enforces the Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code and provides education, information and referrals to city residents in connection with landlord/tenant issues.
rules.summary: Jersey City has a rent control ordinance that regulates rent increases and is administered by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations.
rules.coverage_text: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control
rules.exemption_note: 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; Rent Control Ordinance provides certain exemptions from rent regulation
